short.text: Connor Shaw signed with Jacksonville as an undrafted rookie from South Carolina in May 2014, worked in camp behind Cousins, Henne and Wilson and was waived at the final cuts. A four-year college starter, he brings mobility, ball security and a record of winning, and he kept the launch-point correction from rookie camp. His arm strength and size are ordinary.
